content: In the R. Iʿtiqādiyya, Melvin-Koushki says, Ibn Turka compares himself to Ghazālī and Fakhr al-Dīn Rāzī (al-imāmayn) in their willingness, sprung of intellectual integrity, to delve experimentally into all branches of knowledge.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Iʿtiqādiyya, p.268 (per MK fn.111)
